newsitem.title: USA: E-Z-EM Inc sets 3 pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: E-Z-EM Inc sets 3 pct stock dividend.

text.p: E-Z-EM Inc said on Monday that its board of directors has declared a three percent stock dividend.
The dividend, payable in non-voting class B common stock, is payable on April 21, 1997, to shareholders of record of class A and class B common stock on March 31, 1997, E-Z-EM said.
Shareholders entitled to receive fractional shares of stock will be issued a cash payment in lieu thereof, E-Z-EM said.
The fractional share cash payment will be based on the closing price of class B stock as reported by the American Stock Exchange on March 4, 1997, the company said.
